caption: The drawing features three square pieces of patterned fabric, arranged in a staggered, diagonal formation across a plain, off-white or beige background. The top square depicts a dense plaid pattern in dark blue, red, white, and black colors. The middle square, positioned below and slightly to the right, has a looser plaid or checked pattern in varying shades of blue and white. The bottom square, situated further down and to the right, displays a large checkered pattern in red, pink, and white, bordered by several parallel red lines along its right and lower edges. Each fabric square is distinct in color and design, spaced evenly with the corners nearly touching, and all are rendered with attention to textile detail.
title: Zoar Plaids
